notes.title: Having trouble after an update?
notes.body:
Whenever a new update is released and the game misbehaves (a black screen, missing parts, buttons that do nothing), the best fix is:

1. Close the browser completely (not just the tab).
2. Clear the browser's cache (cached images and files) for this site.
3. Open the game again and reload the page.

The CLEAR GAME CACHE & RELOAD button below does steps 2 and 3 for the game's own stored files. If problems remain, also clear the browser cache from your browser's settings. Your saved journeys are not affected: they are kept separately, and in your GitHub account when signed in.
